props.label: PRIOR ART
props.title: The event-bus question, settled
props.subtitle: "We solved for event bus already" — confirmed

props.content:
The quad-brain consolidation was **already executed in June 2026**: spec-event-architecture §5.0 records the envelope unification — one `LevEvent`, one pattern matcher, one `EventLog` writer, one bus implementation — and the drift ledger marks it RESOLVED. No new design was needed.

What remains is exactly two named residues, now packeted as **L19**: delete `core/poly/src/events` (the February ruling that was never executed — only 2 real importers left) and run the §5.2 de-scope so core/event-bus shrinks to bus + adapters, with the dead `@lev-os/harness` relocation target corrected to `lifecycle`/`exec`. The third adjacent piece — autodev's event-persistence fork — turned out to be already converged in code (**L20**).

Single tracking document: `.lev/pm/roadmap/core-runtime-convergence-master-v2.yaml` — items list (20), execution_sequence, shovel_ready_verification_20260702, pending_operator_amendments. Verification: workflow wf_abb69820-bd1, 16 agents (4 opus, 12 sonnet), 0 errors. New packets on main: `execution-ledger-terminal-event-taxonomy-v1`, `runtime-identity-residue-sweep-v1`, `event-architecture-residue-closeout-v1` — all validate ready:true.
